question_cn: 双车配合对光杆王，最高效的将杀方式称为"割草"。其原理是：
question_en: Two rooks vs. lone king — the most efficient mating method is called 'lawnmower'. The principle is:

options.text_cn: 两车轮流切割，每次把对方王压缩一行，直到边线将死
options.text_en: Rooks alternate cutting, compressing the king one rank at a time until mated on the edge

options.text_cn: 两车同时追杀，不需要有规律
options.text_en: Both rooks chase randomly without a pattern

options.text_cn: 一车保护另一车，等待时机
options.text_en: One rook protects the other while waiting for opportunity

options.text_cn: 用王驱赶，两车只是辅助
options.text_en: Use the king to drive, rooks only assist

explanation_cn: 双车割草是最简单高效的残局杀法之一。两车轮流占据不同横排，像割草机一样把对方王压缩到边线，无需己方王参与也能完成将杀。
explanation_en: The lawnmower is one of the most efficient endgame techniques: rooks alternately cut off ranks, mowing the king to the edge without needing the own king.
